title: Code Review: HTML+JS Web Version (v1.1.0)
description: Review of web/src/main.js, web/src/style.css, web/index.html, web/vite.config.js, web/package.json — the new HTML+JS web port of Lucas' Game implemented in the previous session.

items.title: Missing event.preventDefault() in keydown handler
items.description:
In the PLAYING state keydown handler, browser default actions are not suppressed. Keys like Space (scroll), Tab (focus navigation), ArrowUp/Down (scroll), PageUp/PageDown (scroll) will trigger browser defaults during gameplay — especially during the async window between startGame() and fullscreen being granted, and in any scenario where fullscreen is blocked or unavailable (regular window, file://, Pi kiosk without --kiosk flag).

File: web/src/main.js, event listener ~line 196

Fix: Add event.preventDefault() inside both the TITLE and PLAYING branches of the keydown handler. All keys should suppress defaults once the user has started interacting.
items.resolution: Approved — add event.preventDefault() in both TITLE and PLAYING keydown branches.

items.title: AudioContext not resumed before tone playback
items.resolution: Approved — wrap oscillator scheduling inside audioCtx.resume().then()

items.title: Blank game screen when starting by click (no key)
items.description:
When the user clicks the title screen instead of pressing a key, startGame(null) is called. The title screen hides, the game screen appears, fullscreen is requested — but the game screen is completely empty (white body background, no key wrapper coloring, no text). There is no instruction to prompt the user to press a key.

File: web/src/main.js startGame() + web/index.html game-screen markup, web/src/style.css

Reproduction: Open the page, click anywhere on the title screen with a mouse.

Fix options:
  A) Show a subtle 'Press any key...' hint inside #game-screen when no key has been pressed yet (add a #waiting-hint element, hide it in applyKeyPress())
  B) On body/game-screen show a neutral grey background and the hint text
  C) Don't transition to PLAYING on click — only trigger the game screen after the first actual keydown (click just requests fullscreen)
items.resolution: Approved option A — add #waiting-hint element inside game-screen, hide it in applyKeyPress() on first key press.

items.title: scaleFontSize() causes repeated reflow (layout thrashing)
items.description:
scaleFontSize() reads scrollWidth inside a while-loop that also sets fontSize, forcing a synchronous layout reflow each iteration. For most key names (short strings like 'A', 'F1', 'Esc') this is 1-2 iterations and has no perceptible impact. For longer labels like 'Backspace', 'Page Down', 'CapsLock' it may be 5-10 iterations.

Given the usage context (child presses a key → one update per press, not animated) this is a non-issue in practice, but it is a recognized anti-pattern.

File: web/src/main.js scaleFontSize() ~line 87

Fix (optional): Calculate font size mathematically based on character count and wrapper dimensions, or use a binary search instead of linear step-down. CSS container-query approach (font-size: 100cqi) would eliminate the JS loop entirely but has slightly lower browser support.
items.skip_reason: Negligible impact for per-keypress update pattern. Deferred.
